1.content:
## InspiredLearning operations
Source configuration only. No deployment or native RUM-to-trace linkage is certified. Technical success target: 99.5%; p95 is measured without an invented threshold.

2.title: Technical success (%)
2.query: timeseries {total=sum(inspiredlearning.operation.outcomes, default:0), good=sum(inspiredlearning.operation.outcomes, filter:{outcome != "failure"}, default:0)}, filter:{service.name == "inspiredlearning-api" and deployment.environment.name == "production" and startsWith(operation, "learning.")}, nonempty:true | fieldsAdd sli=100.0*good[]/total[] | fieldsRemove good,total

4.title: Canonical events and trace correlation
4.query: fetch bizevents | filter event.provider == "inspiredlearning" | fields timestamp,event.name,transaction.id,trace_id | lookup [fetch spans | filter service.name == "inspiredlearning-api" | summarize span_count=count(),by:{trace.id}],sourceField:trace_id,lookupField:trace.id,fields:{span_count} | limit 50
